answer: A tight ring of 47 clones therefore holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the knoll calculation reruns each epoch, the garden weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the nectar settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 23% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 10 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
